intent: Approved cinematic construction title screen expressed as live DOM UI, not baked controls.
runtime_rules: all menu controls must remain clickable DOM elements
generated concept images are art direction only and must not bake functional buttons into runtime
new game requires confirmation when progress exists
motion setting must respect user choice and reduced-motion preference
character quotes can be hidden without changing gameplay
short landscape phone keeps only one protagonist visible to avoid duplicate-face lineup until final differentiated title-cast binaries are promoted

breakpoint_notes.desktop: four character foreground plus four feature cards
breakpoint_notes.mobile: hide character foreground and use two-column feature cards
breakpoint_notes.physical_landscape_phone: world-first hero composition: one protagonist only, primary Field Defense CTA dominates, LIVE SITE is compact, feature-card strip and unlabeled quick toggles are hidden, utility remains icon-only

loading.background: same episode background focus as title

map_entry.slate: NEW PSI FIELD / DAY + construction stage
map_entry.camera: loading zoom resolves into live strategy map
map_entry.rule: entry slate is decorative only; gameplay remains interactive after handoff

qa_reference.role: art-direction and layout QA only; not shipped as baked UI
required_hierarchy: white NEW PSI plus warm-yellow ZERO DAY title
five stacked left-side actions with icon, title and hint
four differentiated character silhouettes with quote plus name/role
visible quick motion and quote toggles
construction background remains readable but subordinate to foreground UI

physical_phone_v10.productionRule: desktop can retain four-person ensemble; short landscape phone uses one protagonist until four title binaries are visually differentiated enough for side-by-side display

hierarchy.text: 사고 전 신호를 읽고, 현장을 바꿔라.

h01.briefCopy: 같은 안전관리자라도 현장·공법·공정이 달라지면 읽어야 할 위험은 달라집니다.
rules: NEW PSI is a low-emphasis brand eyebrow and must not compete with PSI : ZERO DAY
primary title, slogan and defense CTA must remain visible without scroll
left hero uses a readability gradient without blurring construction-world detail
no new tutorial or long lore copy is introduced

h02.goal: characters remain emotional anchors while title CTA and LIVE SITE own interaction hierarchy

collisionRules: hero CTA must not be obscured
LIVE SITE must not overlap title copy
character captions must stay clear of feature cards

h02.shortLandscape: one protagonist remains visible; quotes/captions suppressed

h03.interactionRule: presentation upgrade only; no new click behavior

desktop: descriptions visually clamp to one line
shortLandscape: settings remain accessible from top utility
